items.text: DNS-rebinding protection — outbound fetches (preview, ping, icons, auto-heal) validate resolved IPs at dial time; private/loopback targets are blocked unless localhost bookmarks are allowed.

Write-token coverage — when NEXTDASH_WRITE_TOKEN is set, backup download, bookmark preview, search-index build, open-broken, and auto-heal suggest also require X-NextDash-Token. Dashboard, config, and health inject the token automatically.
Font magic bytes — custom font uploads are validated by file signature (WOFF/WOFF2/TTF/OTF), not client Content-Type or filename.
SVG & icon hardening — downloaded SVG icons are sanitized server-side; uploaded icons/favicons use magic-byte detection; category modals escape HTML safely.
Atomic ZIP import — restore stages to a temp directory, removes orphan icons and stale JSON, then commits; invalid bookmark URLs are skipped with a count in the UI.
Backup round-trip icons — legacy root-level images in data/ export as icons/<name> so bookmark icon references survive backup → import.
Factory reset scope — reset clears data/icons/, custom favicon/font, and preview/health caches; sample favicons prefetch in the background after startup.
Settings export/import — export or import settings.json alone from Config → Backups, with file-size validation and migration-safe cleanup.
Last backup date — the backups panel shows when you last created a ZIP backup.
Cache merge safety — preview and health caches use atomic read-merge-write so parallel requests no longer overwrite each other's entries.
Canonical URL keys — duplicate detection, health cache, status monitor, and ping validation treat https://x, https://x/, and https://x:443 as the same URL (same for http://x:80).
Duplicate merge metadata — health merge keeps the best bookmark and combines tags, shortcut, opens, notes, and icons from the removed duplicates.
Open-count tracking — /api/track-open increments atomically under lock (no lost opens on rapid clicks).
Icon upload overwrite — re-uploading a bookmark icon with the same filename replaces the file on disk.
Inline edit saves immediately — rename and delete on the dashboard persist right away (no debounce); pending edits flush when you refresh or close the tab.
Disk write errors — bookmark and settings saves return an error when the server cannot write data, instead of silently failing.
Write-token gaps — health mutations and the bookmarks guided tour use the shared write-token fetch helpers when NEXTDASH_WRITE_TOKEN is set.
Shortcut docs sync — cheatsheet, help text, and config tour match dashboard keys (1–9 page tabs, category jump, etc.).
Link-preview icons — bookmark detail can fetch favicons via link preview with generation guards so stale async responses are ignored.
URL protocol hint — missing https:// on blur is normalized; inline hint when the protocol is absent.
Config tab keys — arrow keys move between visible config tabs on desktop.
Search chip keys — ←/→ select a recent query chip; Enter applies it.
Duplicate-merge modal — ESC cancels the health merge picker without leaving a pending promise.
Unsaved icon edits — icon fetch, upload, clear, and undo mark the bookmark detail as dirty so Save is required.
Config save order — Save posts settings before bookmarks so allowLocalBookmarks applies during URL validation; partial settings POSTs merge with stored values instead of wiping fields.
Private URL save hint — blocked local/private bookmark URLs show a clear error (EN/NL/DE/FR) pointing to General → Advanced or a URL change; the client can auto-enable the localhost flag when needed.
Collapsible structure panel — Config → Bookmarks keeps pages, categories, archived pages, and favicon policy in a collapsed Structure block until you expand it.
Add bookmark menu — + Bookmark dropdown: Add & edit opens the detail panel (Save when ready) or Quick add saves immediately.
Detail panel tiers — category stays visible; shortcut, icon, tags, previews, and status live under a More options collapsible.
Bulk move toolbar — one Move to row (page + category + Apply) replaces separate category-move and page-move groups.
Split view polish — responsive list/detail layout, glass and modern styling for workspace card and bulk toolbar; bookmarks guided tour copy updated.
:health command — open /health from command mode with filters (broken, duplicate, stale, …) or refresh to re-scan; cheat sheet and help updated.
Health URL deep links — ?filter=, ?page=, ?sort=, ?q=, ?refresh=1 apply on load; refresh=1 triggers retest-all.
Health badge routing — dashboard and config health links go to /health?filter=broken when broken issues exist.
Essentials Health → link — Config → General → Essentials status Health → uses the same broken-filter routing as the header badge.
Config health link selector — header health anchor matches href^="/health" so badge href updates survive after the first refresh.
:stale overflow — when the stale palette exceeds its cap, the overflow row opens /health?filter=stale.
Try modern & Try glass — classic-layout users see a layout-versions spotlight with Try modern and Try glass; onboarding and feature-tour copy cover all three versions.
Unified spotlight flow — one discoverability path for classic → modern or glass; reset from Advanced → System & tools replays the spotlight.
Discoverability queue bar — layout-versions and paste spotlights show Tip X of Y and Later this session; defer skips remaining post-onboarding prompts this session (EN/NL/DE/FR).
Preset fine-tuning — terminal (transparent default, glass on hover), masonry (subtle border, glass on hover), launcher (lighter surface, gentler hover lift).
Design tokens — --layout-surface-inset and --glass-blur-* replace hardcoded blur values across dashboard, config, health, and modal overlays.
Glass UI details — inline-edit panel, tag-autocomplete dropdown, loading skeleton shimmer, and config bookmarks workspace glass parity.
Ping write-token — /api/ping requires X-NextDash-Token when NEXTDASH_WRITE_TOKEN is set; status monitor and health UI send it automatically.

Health mutation races — health status updates, deletes, auto-heal, RetestAll, and preview bulk clear/refresh apply atomically via MutateBookmarksOnPage; duplicate merge commits all page updates in one locked save.
ZIP import categories — restored pages keep category structure because categories are merged into bookmark JSON before import commit.
Page load race — fast swipe or hash changes no longer show the wrong bookmarks; stale loadPageBookmarks() responses are ignored.
Delete & open tracking — delete matches canonical URLs and returns 404 when missing; /api/track-open uses page-aware index resolution; persist failures return 500 instead of 404.
Inline edit & page moves — remote bookmarks save note and tags; the page dropdown can move cross-page bookmarks; category reorder flushes on tab close.
SavePages & icon preview — saving page order/name no longer overwrites bookmark data on disk; inline icon preview uses safe DOM rendering.
Immediate dashboard saves — bookmark reorder and preview metadata save right away; tab hide flushes pending saves; remote bookmarks can be deleted from inline edit in tag-filter view.
Swipe navigation — page swipes no longer call updatePageTitle separately; loadPageBookmarks() owns title and hash updates.

Settings search promo — on desktop config, a pulsing search field, New badge, and speech balloon highlight global settings search (Ctrl+Shift+K / Cmd+Shift+K); Ctrl+K stays quick actions only. Shown once; skips mobile and active tours.

Settings search polish — results stack above the promo balloon; typing dismisses it; tour wait capped at 30 retries; config category rows use safe DOM rendering; Help footer GitHub link uses nextdash repo casing.

Glass layout — third layout version with translucent iOS-style blur on dashboard, config, and health. Choose in Config → General → Layout, onboarding, or :layoutversion glass; :layoutversion toggle cycles classic → modern → glass. Modern unchanged.
Layout settings save — layout version, preset, and density persist from config (included on Save; layout changes autosave to the server).
Docker UI refresh — container serves mounted static/, locales/, and templates/ from disk when present so UI updates apply without rebuilding the image.
Docker build context — expanded .dockerignore excludes node_modules/, local data/, dev scripts, and docs so image builds stay lean.

Repo hygiene — .gitignore merge conflict resolved; node_modules/ removed from git; Playwright stays a devDependency for local debug scripts only; obsolete merge-config-info-i18n.py migration script removed.
